sloka: नृशंसे पापसंकल्पे रामं स्त्यपराक्रमम् ।किम् विप्रियेण कैकेयि प्रियं योजयसे मम ॥२-१३-१३॥
transliteration: nṛśaṁse pāpasaṁkalpe rāmaṁ styaparākramam ।kim vipriyeṇa kaikeyi priyaṁ yojayase mama ॥2-13-13॥

translations.english: O cruel, malevolent Kaikeyi, why do you propose such a harmful act against Rama who has truth as his prowess and who is so dear to me? Certainly, you will get unparalleled infamy and disgrace in this world.
translations.hindi: हे कौसल्या जी के शोभन पुत्र ! आपको कैकेयी सहित महाराज देखना चाहते हैं, अतः आप तुरन्त वहाँ चले
